items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: And then I read somewhere that you were on that original recording, is that right?

ctx.x: I don’t know what it is. I always make a joke and say we’re the only ones dumb enough to want to play — to want to work that hard. No I don’t know what it is, there are a darm lot of — yeah that trumpet section with Tom Jones, it was a total Italian trumpet section.

Wow. I’ve noticed a couple of interesting little things along the way and I’ll mention two of them. I used to do a show with an Elvis act here locally. And we used to play that tune “American Trilogy.” And then I read somewhere that you were on that original recording, is that right?
